visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey crop top and white trousers, sits in a studio environment. She holds a smartphone displaying an Instagram Story interface with a 3D avatar beside her photo. She points excitedly at the screen. (2) Close-up shot of the smartphone screen showing the 'RoboNeo' AI app interface. A hand with manicured nails selects a photo from the gallery and types a detailed prompt in traditional Chinese. (3) The app processes the request, showing a loading animation, then displays a high-quality 3D emoji-style avatar that closely resembles the woman in the photo. (4) The user demonstrates the iOS 'cut-out' feature by long-pressing the generated image in the Photos app, converting it into a sticker with a white outline. (5) The screen shows the sticker being used within iMessage and Instagram chats, showing its functionality across different platforms. (6) The camera returns to the woman in the studio. She talks animatedly with the person filming, making various hand gestures and expressions of surprise and excitement as they discuss creative uses for the stickers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Female voice A (enthusiastic, high pitch) exclaims 'Hey look, this can make your own Emoji!' against an upbeat electronic pop BGM. Female voice B reacts with high arousal, saying 'So cute!'. (2) Female voice A begins a tutorial narration with clear articulation. A 'pop' SFX accompanies the screen transition. The BGM remains steady with a strong synthesizer pulse. (3) A 'whoosh' SFX triggers as the AI processes the image. Voice B reacts with a surprised 'Wow!' as the result is shown. (4) The narration continues at a fast speech rate, explaining technical steps. Tapping sounds on the screen are audible as incidental noise. (5) Voice A explains platform limitations in a slightly more professional tone. The BGM intensity remains constant. (6) Laughter from both voices signals a shift to a casual conversation. A 'ding' SFX marks the final prompt as the BGM builds up toward a hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Intro -> Demonstration -> Tutorial -> Usage Limitations -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the capabilities of the RoboNeo AI app in creating personalized 3D emoji stickers from photos and to provide a step-by-step guide for viewers to replicate the process on their own devices.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names 'RoboNeo' as an AI app developed by Meitu and demonstrates its primary features in a promotional manner.
